---
title: "Date Formatting"
author: "Norah Jones"
date: "2026-07-01"
date-modified: "03/07/2026"
date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z, P4 bd-13f821l5): dates are
# parsed (multiple input forms) and formatted per date-format before
# templating; the head's dcterms.date keeps the ISO form via the
# derived date-meta (deliberate deviation from Q1, which leaks the
# formatted string into the machine slot).
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      dom-parity: true
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.date",
            "div.quarto-title-meta p.date-modified",
          ]
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<p class=\"date\">Jul 1, 2026</p>",
            "<p class=\"date-modified\">Mar 7, 2026</p>",
            "<meta name=\"dcterms.date\" content=\"2026-07-01\">",
          ]
        - ["<p class=\"date\">2026-07-01</p>"]
---

Body.
